title: Hilbert-Schmidt norm: continuity and comparison with the operator norm
statement: For all natural numbers m, k: the squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm hsNormSq(A) = sum over i < m of |A e_i|^2 (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1, the standard basis of R^m) is a continuous function of A on the space of continuous linear maps R^m -> R^k with the operator-norm topology; and for every such A: 0 <= hsNormSq(A), hsNormSq(A) <= m ||A||^2 where ||A|| is the operator norm, and |A v|^2 <= hsNormSq(A) |v|^2 for every v in R^m.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ), Continuous (fun A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k => hsNormSq A) ∧ ∀ A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k, 0 ≤ hsNormSq A ∧ hsNormSq A ≤ m * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ∧ ∀ v : Rn m, ‖A v‖ ^ 2 ≤ hsNormSq A * ‖v‖ ^ 2
